I was so confused, i told her that your shop guy has taken the product while against the delivery of the medicine… Upon which she said that he never returned the product to the shop, hence she cant help me with any refund or adjustments towards any product i wish to buy. I said the guy whom i returned the product was your appointed person and that it wasn’t my concern if he didn’t return the product to you, and that  she can call the delivery person and confirm the same in front of me, for which said something which really triggered me to another level, she said “ ohh he’s not been coming to work since last 2 months as he’s been possessed by some evil, and hence i wouldn’t call him.” Thats a lie!.. cant imagine what reasons they render just to avoid few bucks.

She is extremely rude, and despite of working in a service industry in todays world, you cant have such sick and unapologetic attitude.

Would definitely request every pet owner to think twice before giving any business to such shops.
They are just not worth it.
